quote.text: For my part, I travel not to go anywhere, but to go. I travel for travel’s sake. The great affair is to move.
quote.author: Robert Louis Stevenson, Travels with a Donkey in the Cévennes (1879), “Cheylard and Luc”

stories.headline: The good toe costs about a dollar. The rest is brand
stories.dek: Gauge is a needle count, not a quality ladder. And the word the trade uses for the premium finish may mean the cheap one.

stories.kicker: Down the Rabbit Hole · Distance Skating
stories.headline: No tricks, no park. The unit of achievement is a distance
stories.dek: A forty-four-year-old came back to skateboarding this month to cruise without breaking anything. He posted five more times in nine days.

stories.headline: A third date for the shuttle nobody has ridden
stories.dek: The Johor link slipped again on 2 October, from January to February. Everything built is built; what is missing is a safety certificate.

stories.headline: One official switched the dollar off, then on
stories.dek: At 2.43pm in Washington on Friday, the same director who had just listed an international court authorised the import of Russian diesel. Both measures run 180 days.

stories.headline: Parliament went after the listing, not the vehicle
stories.dek: Four Acts rewritten at once, and the new offence is publishing. Importing an illegal device and advertising one now carry the same ceiling.

stories.headline: The jury deliberated four hours, then went home
stories.dek: Wilmington is being asked to price something no chip contains: permission to design one. Deliberations resume Tuesday, two days after this issue prints.

stories.headline: Garmin sent no review units. That is the review
stories.dek: A new strap, a faster chip and thirty-two more gigabytes, at a hundred dollars over the street price of the watch it replaces. Singapore has a listing but no price.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Bremont’s Deep Blue
stories.headline: The limit exists. The premium for it does not
stories.dek: Two hundred and fifty pieces, says the product page. The collection grid beside it prints no limit at all — and charges the same for an unlimited sibling.

stories.headline: Eighteen per cent, and twelve million on Friday
stories.dek: Universal did not screen it for American critics. Fifty-six reviews landed in a day once the embargo lifted, and the audience had already bought the ticket.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Chronotype At Twelve
stories.headline: The late bedtime does nothing at eleven
stories.dek: A causal-inference study of 7,489 children finds no effect a year earlier, and at twelve to thirteen the one thing parents fear most is the one thing it does not find.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · A Diesel Shock
stories.headline: Gold rose with the dollar. Bitcoin did not
stories.dek: One force ran the week, and it was refined product, not crude. Central banks cannot ease against a supply shock, so the hedges sorted themselves.

stories.headline: Not how much you move — how readily you stop
stories.dek: Half a million treadmill tests produced the week’s biggest number and its smallest gain. A study a hundredth the size found something more useful.

stories.headline: One on-sale falls inside this week. Set an alarm
stories.dek: Nothing here is printed on an aggregator’s word alone. Six listings could not be stood up at a primary source and are named at the foot.

stories.headline: For thirty-two years, a tax table wrote the recipes
stories.dek: On 1 October Japan flattened the rates that invented an entire category of drink. Six days later its competition regulators raided all four brewers, and the trade body itself.
